description: This file provides date and time utility functions for formatting, parsing, and manipulating dates and durations, including functions for formatting dates in specific zones, calculating durations, and converting dates to strings.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Formats a date according to the specified format, handling various input types including time.Time and integers representing Unix timestamps.

methods.name: htmlDate
methods.description: Returns a date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD' in the local timezone.

methods.name: htmlDateInZone
methods.description: Returns a date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD' in the specified timezone.

methods.name: dateInZone
methods.description: Converts a date to a specified format and timezone, handling multiple input types.

methods.name: dateModify
methods.description: Modifies a date by adding a duration specified as a string.

methods.name: mustDateModify
methods.description: Modifies a date by adding a duration, returning an error if parsing fails.

methods.name: dateAgo
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the duration since the given date.

methods.name: duration
methods.description: Converts a number of seconds (as string or int64) into a duration string.

methods.name: durationRound
methods.description: Returns a rounded duration string (e.g., '2h', '3d') based on the input duration or time.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a time.Time object using the specified format and local timezone.

methods.name: mustToDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a time.Time object, returning an error if parsing fails.

methods.name: unixEpoch
methods.description: Returns the Unix timestamp as a string for a given date.
